get.summary: Read one project conversation, jobs, worker index and project list
get.description: Supports after integer message cursor. messages are ascending and omit unavailable assistant source updates, never user-authored turns. next_after advances over raw retained rows (including suppressed rows); has_more governs paging. Every page includes suppressed_sources, the current canonical source-ID suppression snapshot. Clients must evict matching retained assistant cards and reply metadata even when messages is empty. suppress_source_updates fails closed if the bounded projection is exceeded. When a previously suppressed source becomes available, replay from after=0 with ID deduplication. job_id correlates sends; jobs excludes completed jobs. Polling is read-only and does not perform network visibility checks.
